note: Adapted from the species-level description in Krishna & Araujo 1968, a revision of the Neotropical genus Neocapritermes (Bulletin of the American Museum of Natural History 138), the original in English; the alate and the soldier are described, while the worker is only named and has no descriptive text. The type-specimen column of Table 8 does not agree with the ranges and means given in the same row (for example head capsule length in lateral view 2.96 against a range of 2.55—2.75, postmentum length 1.89 against 1.63—1.79), which is judged to be an OCR column misalignment; that column was not used. The synonymy list, the localities and the type material are omitted.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: The alate is distinctly smaller than N. angusticeps, N. opacus and N. taracua in all measurements; the hind tibial spur formula is 2:2:2 in N. bodkini and 3:2:2 in this species. The soldier is closest to N. taracua, both having long mandibles and the tip of the left mandible sharp and hook-shaped; but in N. taracua all parts are larger, the antennae are 16-segmented, and the anterior margin of the labrum bears a small tuberculate projection.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head pale yellow to pale brown, the anterior margin and the edges of the pronotum darker; antennae and mouthparts straw yellow to pale brown; mandibles dark brown to shiny black; thorax tinged with yellow, abdomen dirty white. Head sparsely covered with fine, small dark setae of two lengths; postmentum with numerous minute erect setae and one long seta at each anterior corner; labrum with several setae of three kinds; pronotum with several long, rather strong hairs; legs sparsely hairy, the longitudinal keel of the fore coxa with a small row of irregular setae; abdomen moderately hairy. Head elongate, 1.7 times as long as wide, the sides parallel, the posterior corners rounded into the slightly curved posterior margin; vertex in lateral view straight, gently rounded towards the posterior margin and sloping over a short distance towards the frons; fontanelle very small, situated in a shallow depression. Antennae 15-segmented, segment 3 inflated and darker, segment 4 shortest, segments 5—10 progressively longer, segments 11—14 slightly decreasing in length, segment 15 elongate-oval and slightly longer than the preceding one. Labrum asymmetrical, with a shallow constriction on each side, the anterior margin oblique and with a notch in its left half, the tip obtusely rounded and deflected to the right. Mandibles rather slender, only slightly shorter than the head, the ratio of mandible to head length 0.9; left mandible strongly curved at the base, thereafter slightly undulate to the inflated distal part, ending in a short, sharp, upturned hook; right mandible slightly shorter than the left, shallowly concave dorsally at the base, ending in a rather sharp, incurved point. Postmentum rod-shaped, the sides strongly divergent near the base, the posterior margin slightly concave, parallel in the middle, the distal sides expanded and gently curved into the straight anterior margin. Pronotum narrower than the head, 0.6 of the head width, the lateral lobes gently curved and not angulate; anterior lobe longer, semicircular, the anterior margin with a short, shallow median notch; posterior lobe broadly semicircular, the middle of the posterior margin short and straight; mesonotum obliquely curved on both sides into the straight posterior margin; metanotum about as wide as the pronotum, concave in the middle dorsally, the posterior margin with a wide, shallow median emargination. Middle tibia without spines. Measurements (8 soldiers, range and mean): head capsule length in lateral view 2.55—2.75 mm (mean 2.65), maximum head width 1.33—1.40 mm (1.35), maximum head height 1.03—1.12 mm (1.07), left mandible length 2.42—2.60 mm (2.52), right mandible length 2.19—2.40 mm (2.28), postmentum maximum width 0.41—0.46 mm (0.45), minimum width 0.26—0.28 mm (0.26), length 1.63—1.79 mm (1.70), pronotum median length 0.41—0.51 mm (0.47), maximum width 0.84—0.89 mm (0.86), hind tibia length 1.22—1.33 mm (1.28).

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule pale reddish brown; antennae, mouthparts and mandibles (except the tips) straw-coloured; thorax paler than the head capsule; legs straw-coloured, the wing scales darker; abdomen slightly darker than the thorax; wings slightly tinged with brown, the veins pale brown. Head capsule with numerous nearly colourless, erect, fine hairs of two lengths, sparser on the sides; postclypeus with very few hairs, labrum with about 6 rather long setae; margins of the pronotum with long and short setae, the disc covered with very short microtrichia; mesonotum and metanotum slightly covered with microtrichia, the margins with very short hairs; legs moderately hairy, the tibiae more densely so; wing scales mostly with rather long hairs and densely covered with short microtrichia; wing membrane with minute recumbent hairs, slightly longer at the margins; abdominal segments sparsely hairy. Head in lateral view slightly concave around the fontanelle plate, sloping in front of the ocelli; compound eyes strongly convex; ocelli elongate-oval, the posterior margin straight and the remainder semicircular. Antennae 16-segmented, segments 3 and 4 very short, segments 5—8 progressively longer, segments 8—14 nearly equal in length, segment 15 slightly shorter, segment 16 elongate-oval and slightly shorter than the preceding one. Pronotum 0.81 of the head width, mostly flat, the anterior margin straight and slightly upturned in the middle, the sides semicircular, the posterior margin with a shallow emargination; posterior margin of the mesonotum with a distinct, deep, right-angled median notch and projecting lateral angles, the metanotal posterior notch shallower. Measurements (3 alates, range and mean): head capsule length in lateral view 0.87—0.92 mm (mean 0.90), head width including compound eyes 1.22 mm, compound eye diameter 0.38—0.41 mm (0.40), distance from the compound eye to the lower margin of the head 0.05—0.08 mm (0.06), ocellus long diameter 0.12—0.14 mm (0.12), short diameter 0.10 mm, distance from the ocellus to the compound eye 0.05—0.06 mm (0.05), fontanelle plate long diameter 0.10—0.12 mm (0.11), pronotum median length 0.61 mm, maximum length 0.62—0.66 mm (0.64), maximum width 1.00 mm, hind tibia length 1.48—1.58 mm (1.53), forewing length from the suture 9.70—9.80 mm (9.75), width 2.50—2.60 mm (2.55).
